observations: Wall-mounted salon hair dryer unit with a large hood/nozzle and adjustable arm.
White main body with black interior/ducting and black control panel area.
Visible brand text on the front label: “MANGO” (photos 0, 1, 2, 3).
Control knobs/switches are visible on the front panel (photos 0, 1, 2, 3).
No clear view of power rating, model number, or heating element specs in the photos.
Photos show the unit installed on a wall; no close-up of the plug/cable condition.

claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: Brand “MANGO” is visible on the unit’s front label in photos 0/1/2/3.
No photo evidence of purchase date, usage hours, or service history.
Photos show no obvious cracks/damage, but condition of heating/airflow and internal parts cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Heating may be weak or not working (common issue for salon dryers). Photos cannot confirm airflow temperature or heat output.
risks.proof: A short video of the unit switched on showing: (1) fan/airflow running, (2) heat warming within 1–2 minutes, and (3) any indicator lights/temperature setting changes.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed to heat properly (worst case: treat as needs testing/possible repair).

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (wiring, switch, or control panel faults) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the plug and cable end + a video showing stable operation (no sparking, no burning smell) when turned on.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as electrically untested (worst case: assume may require inspection).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or mounting hardware for removal/reinstallation.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included: mounting bracket/bolts, any manual, and the full cable/plug length; plus a clip showing how it’s mounted.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as buyer may need to source mounting parts (worst case: no extras).

risks.risk: Model/spec mismatch (power rating/heat modes) affects value; photos don’t show the exact model or wattage.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating plate/spec label (voltage/wattage/model) on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic Mango wall salon dryer without confirmed specs.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating plate/spec label (voltage/wattage/model number).
Video test: turn on and demonstrate airflow + heating within 1–2 minutes.
Photo of the plug/cable and any visible wiring/control panel details.
Photos of included mounting hardware/accessories (or confirm none).
response.reason: The photos identify it as a Mango wall salon hair dryer, but key value drivers (heating performance, electrical safety, and exact model/specs) are not verifiable remotely. To price confidently, we need a rating-plate close-up and a working test video.
